item.title: Humboldt Broncos families will appeal decision to dismiss lawsuit, lawyer says
item.description: A Saskatoon King's Bench Court judge dismissed the lawsuit initially filed in July 2018, just months after a semi-trailer went through a stop sign and collided with the junior hockey team’s bus, killing 16 people. Their lawyer says they will appeal.

item.title: N.S. fiddler Ashley MacIssac says AI content may have defamed him
item.description: Nova Scotia fiddler Ashley MacIsaac said the summary falsely asserted he had been convicted of a series of offences, including sexual assault and internet luring.

item.title: American billionaire wins defamation lawsuit against Peter Nygard
item.description: Billionaire hedge fund manager Louis Bacon has won his long-running defamation lawsuit alleging that former fashion mogul and convicted sex offender Peter Nygard spread lies about him during a public spat over their adjacent properties in the Bahamas.

item.title: It's so cold in the Yukon, the power grid can't keep up
item.description: Frigid temperatures that hover around -40 C — or -50 C in some communities — continue to keep much of the territory in their grip. There’s no sign of that weather, patterns of which are coming from Siberia, easing up any time soon.

item.title: Bitter feud ensues after landlord's failed attempt to raise tenants' rent 65%
item.description: A New Brunswick tenant and his landlord have been in a bitter year-long dispute that involves a 65 per cent rent increase, a failed eviction attempt, and claims that the rental unit, a bungalow, is needed to house the owner's aging mother-in-law.
